about:
CKS Packaging, a Covenant Company, operates from Urbana, Illinois, where it was founded in 2007. The business is family-owned and operated, drawing on 70 years of industry experience.

The company manufactures blow-molded plastic containers, serving as both an American manufacturer and a North American supplier. Its production focuses on blow molding processes for a range of container types, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed. The product catalog includes containers for various applications.

CKS Packaging serves a diverse customer base across beverage, food, household, automotive, agricultural chemical, and specialty markets. The company references a prestigious list of customers in these sectors, though individual client names are not provided. Recent product news highlights packaging for peanuts and automotive performance applications.

The firm emphasizes its family-owned heritage and seven decades of experience as key differentiators, positioning itself as a domestic manufacturer with a North American supply footprint. The "Why CKS" section suggests a focus on maximum impact, though specific claims are not detailed.
